example.question: What did Jesus promise his disciples in Acts 1:4?
example.correct_answer: The gift of the Holy Spirit

CRES.G2.THE_CH.THE_HOLY_SPIRIT.HS_PROMIS.cause: Promises at home are often about things.
CRES.G2.THE_CH.THE_HOLY_SPIRIT.HS_PROMIS.reveals: Offer "Money" beside "The gift of the Holy Spirit" and ask the child to choose.
CRES.G2.THE_CH.THE_HOLY_SPIRIT.HS_PROMIS.feedback: Jesus promised to send the Holy Spirit.

example.question: Where did Jesus tell the disciples to wait?

CRES.G2.THE_CH.THE_HOLY_SPIRIT.HS_PROMIS.error: Thinks the Holy Spirit punishes children who do wrong.

example.question: Name a role of the Holy Spirit.

CRES.G2.THE_CH.THE_HOLY_SPIRIT.HS_PROMIS.cause: Unseen powers are pictured as scary.
CRES.G2.THE_CH.THE_HOLY_SPIRIT.HS_PROMIS.reveals: Offer "He punishes us" beside "He helps (teaches, guides, strengthens) us" and ask the child to choose.
CRES.G2.THE_CH.THE_HOLY_SPIRIT.HS_PROMIS.feedback: The Holy Spirit helps, teaches and guides Christians.

CRES.G2.THE_CH.THE_HOLY_SPIRIT.HS_PROMIS.error: Thinks a promise does not have to be kept, so Jesus' promise may not come true.

example.question: Did Jesus keep his promise to send the Holy Spirit?
